Meera's story is spread across a survey sheet, a paper register, a voice note and a WhatsApp thread. Two of the pieces that matter most are already slipping away. The funder asks a simple question nobody can answer.
EdZola steps in. We design the system around Meera, build it, and run it with AI and people. Every piece lands in one record, and a clean line connects the field to the funder, and back.
Then it scales. Thousands of people, each with one clear thread. Evidence flows up to funders, alerts flow back to the field, and Meera is still one person, not a number.
